metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
units.rightText: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.

units.leftText: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
units.rightText: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
leftNotes: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
units.rightText: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

units.leftText: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
units.rightText: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.

units.leftText: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
units.rightText: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

units.leftText: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
units.rightText: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

units.leftText: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
units.rightText: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
rightNotes: 2:1 Or noisily assemble; see Revelation 11:18|REV 11:18*.

units.leftText: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
units.rightText: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
leftNotes: 2:2 The word “Anointed” is the same as the word for “Messiah” or “Christ”
rightNotes: 2:2 Cited in Acts 4:25–26|ACT 4:25-26*

units.leftText: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
units.rightText: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”

units.leftText: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
units.rightText: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
leftNotes: 2:4 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
units.rightText: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:

units.leftText: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
units.rightText: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

units.leftText: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
units.rightText: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
rightNotes: 2:7 Literally today I have begotten You; cited in Acts 13:33|ACT 13:33*, Hebrews 1:5, and Hebrews 5:5

units.leftText: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
units.rightText: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.

units.leftText: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
units.rightText: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery. ”
rightNotes: 2:9 LXX You will rule them or You will shepherd them
2:9 Cited in Revelation 2:27|REV 2:27*; see also Revelation 12:5 and Revelation 19:15.

units.leftText: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
units.rightText: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.

units.leftText: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
units.rightText: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

units.leftText: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
units.rightText: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
leftNotes: 2:12 or, Kiss the son

units.leftText: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!

units.leftText: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.*
units.rightText: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
leftNotes: 3:2 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים*” (Elohim).
rightNotes: 3:2 Selah or Interlude is probably a musical or literary term; here and throughout the Psalms.

units.leftText: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

units.leftText: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.*
units.rightText: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah

units.leftText: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
units.rightText: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

units.leftText: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
units.rightText: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.

units.leftText: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

units.leftText: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.*
units.rightText: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah

units.leftText: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

units.leftText: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.*
units.rightText: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ? Selah
rightNotes: 4:2 Or false gods

units.leftText: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
units.rightText: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

units.leftText: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.*
units.rightText: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
rightNotes: 4:4 Or In your anger do not sin or Tremble and do not sin; cited in Ephesians 4:26|EPH 4:26*

units.leftText: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
units.rightText: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

units.leftText: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
units.rightText: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

units.leftText: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
units.rightText: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.

units.leftText: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
units.rightText: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

units.leftText: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

units.leftText: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
units.rightText: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

units.leftText: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
units.rightText: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

units.leftText: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
units.rightText: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

units.leftText: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
units.rightText: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

units.leftText: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
units.rightText: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

units.leftText: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
units.rightText: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
rightNotes: 5:7 Forms of the Hebrew chesed are translated here and in most cases throughout the Scriptures as loving devotion; the range of meaning includes love, goodness, kindness, faithfulness, and mercy, as well as loyalty to a covenant.

units.leftText: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
units.rightText: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

units.leftText: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
units.rightText: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
rightNotes: 5:9 Or flattery; cited in Romans 3:13|ROM 3:13*

units.leftText: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
units.rightText: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

units.leftText: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
units.rightText: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

units.leftText: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
units.rightText: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

units.leftText: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
rightNotes: 6:1 Sheminithis probably a musical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:21|1CH 15:21* and Psalm 12:1.

units.leftText: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
units.rightText: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

units.leftText: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
units.rightText: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

units.leftText: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
units.rightText: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
units.rightText: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
leftNotes: 6:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
units.rightText: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

units.leftText: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
units.rightText: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

units.leftText: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
units.rightText: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

units.leftText: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
units.rightText: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

units.leftText: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
units.rightText: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

units.leftText: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
units.rightText: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
rightNotes: 7:1 Shiggaion is probably a musical or liturgical term.

units.leftText: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
units.rightText: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

units.leftText: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
units.rightText: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,

units.leftText: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
units.rightText: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
rightNotes: 7:4 Hebrew the one at peace with me

units.leftText: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.*
units.rightText: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah

units.leftText: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.

units.leftText: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
units.rightText: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.

units.leftText: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
units.rightText: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.

units.leftText: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
units.rightText: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
rightNotes: 7:9 Hebrew hearts and kidneys

units.leftText: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
units.rightText: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

units.leftText: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
units.rightText: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.

units.leftText: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
units.rightText: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.

units.leftText: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
units.rightText: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.

units.leftText: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
units.rightText: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
leftNotes: 7:14 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

units.leftText: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
units.rightText: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.

units.leftText: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
units.rightText: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
units.rightText: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

units.leftText: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
rightNotes: 8:1 Gittith is probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in Psalms 81 and 84.

units.leftText: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
units.rightText: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
rightNotes: 8:2 Literally You have ordained strength; LXX You have prepared praise; cited in Matthew 21:16|MAT 21:16*

units.leftText: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
units.rightText: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place —

units.leftText: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
units.rightText: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

units.leftText: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
units.rightText: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
leftNotes: 8:5 Hebrew: Elohim. The word Elohim, used here, usually means “God”, but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”. The Septuagint reads “angels” here. See also the quote from the Septuagint in Hebrews 2:7.
rightNotes: 8:5 Or than God or than the heavenly beings; see also LXX.

units.leftText: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
units.rightText: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
rightNotes: 8:6 Cited in 1 Corinthians 15:27|1CO 15:27* and Hebrews 2:6–8

units.leftText: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
units.rightText: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,

units.leftText: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
units.rightText: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

units.leftText: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
units.rightText: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

units.leftText: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
rightNotes: 9:1 Psalms 9 and 10 together follow an acrostic pattern, each stanza beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet. In the LXX they form one psalm.

units.leftText: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
units.rightText: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

units.leftText: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
units.rightText: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.

units.leftText: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
units.rightText: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.

units.leftText: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
units.rightText: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.

units.leftText: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
units.rightText: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.

units.leftText: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
units.rightText: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.

units.leftText: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
units.rightText: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.

units.leftText: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
units.rightText: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

units.leftText: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
units.rightText: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

units.leftText: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
units.rightText: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.

units.leftText: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
units.rightText: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

units.leftText: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
units.rightText: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,

units.leftText: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: that I may declare all Your praises — that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.

units.leftText: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
units.rightText: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

units.leftText: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.*
units.rightText: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
rightNotes: 9:16 Higgaion Selah or quiet interlude is probably a musical or liturgical term.

units.leftText: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
units.rightText: The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
leftNotes: 9:17 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
units.rightText: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.

units.leftText: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
units.rightText: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.

units.leftText: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.*
units.rightText: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

units.leftText: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
units.rightText: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?

units.leftText: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
units.rightText: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

units.leftText: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
units.rightText: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

units.leftText: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
units.rightText: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

units.leftText: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
units.rightText: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.

units.leftText: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
units.rightText: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

units.leftText: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
units.rightText: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
rightNotes: 10:7 LXX bitterness; cited in Romans 3:14|ROM 3:14*

units.leftText: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
units.rightText: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

units.leftText: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
units.rightText: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.

units.leftText: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
units.rightText: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.
rightNotes: 10:10 Or He crouches and lies low

units.leftText: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
units.rightText: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

units.leftText: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

units.leftText: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
units.rightText: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

units.leftText: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
units.rightText: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

units.leftText: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
units.rightText: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

units.leftText: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
units.rightText: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

units.leftText: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
units.rightText: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,

units.leftText: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
units.rightText: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.

units.leftText: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!

units.leftText: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
units.rightText: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

units.leftText: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
units.rightText: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”

units.leftText: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
units.rightText: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

units.leftText: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
units.rightText: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.

units.leftText: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
units.rightText: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.

units.leftText: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
units.rightText: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.

units.leftText: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
rightNotes: 12:1 Sheminithis probably a musical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:21|1CH 15:21* and Psalm 6:1.

units.leftText: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
units.rightText: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

units.leftText: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
units.rightText: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.

units.leftText: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
units.rightText: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips— who can be our master?”

units.leftText: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
units.rightText: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
units.rightText: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
rightNotes: 12:6 Probable reading; MT like silver refined in a furnace of clay, purified sevenfold

units.leftText: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
units.rightText: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.

units.leftText: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
units.rightText: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.

units.leftText: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

units.leftText: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
units.rightText: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?

units.leftText: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
units.rightText: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

units.leftText: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
units.rightText: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.

units.leftText: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
units.rightText: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

units.leftText: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
units.rightText: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.

units.leftText: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
rightNotes: 14:1 The Hebrew words rendered fool throughout the Psalms denote one who is morally deficient.

units.leftText: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
units.rightText: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

units.leftText: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
units.rightText: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
rightNotes: 14:3 LXX worthless
14:3 Cited in Romans 3:10–12|ROM 3:10-12*

units.leftText: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
units.rightText: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.

units.leftText: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
units.rightText: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.

units.leftText: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
units.rightText: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.

units.leftText: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
units.rightText: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

units.leftText: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?

units.leftText: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
units.rightText: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,

units.leftText: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
units.rightText: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,

units.leftText: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
units.rightText: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,

units.leftText: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
units.rightText: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

units.leftText: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
units.rightText: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
rightNotes: 16:1 Miktam is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalm 16 and Psalms 56–60.

units.leftText: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
units.rightText: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”

units.leftText: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
units.rightText: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.

units.leftText: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
units.rightText: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.

units.leftText: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
units.rightText: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.

units.leftText: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
units.rightText: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.

units.leftText: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
units.rightText: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
rightNotes: 16:7 Or my heart instructs me; Hebrew my kidneys instruct me

units.leftText: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
units.rightText: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
rightNotes: 16:8 LXX I foresaw

units.leftText: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
units.rightText: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
rightNotes: 16:9 LXX will dwell in hope

units.leftText: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
units.rightText: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
leftNotes: 16:10 Sheol is the place of the dead.
rightNotes: 16:10 Cited in Acts 13:35|ACT 13:35*

units.leftText: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
units.rightText: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
rightNotes: 16:11 Cited in Acts 2:25–28|ACT 2:25-28*

units.leftText: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
units.rightText: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.

units.leftText: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
units.rightText: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.

units.leftText: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
units.rightText: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.

units.leftText: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
units.rightText: As for the deeds of men — by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.

units.leftText: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
units.rightText: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.

units.leftText: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
units.rightText: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.

units.leftText: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
units.rightText: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.

units.leftText: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
units.rightText: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
rightNotes: 17:8 Literally as the pupil, the daughter of

units.leftText: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
units.rightText: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

units.leftText: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
units.rightText: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.

units.leftText: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
units.rightText: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,

units.leftText: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
units.rightText: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.

units.leftText: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,

units.leftText: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
units.rightText: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
rightNotes: 17:14 Or May what You have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies

units.leftText: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
units.rightText: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.

units.leftText: I love you, LORD, my strength.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.

units.leftText: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
units.rightText: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

units.leftText: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
units.rightText: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

units.leftText: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
units.rightText: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.

units.leftText: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
units.rightText: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
leftNotes: 18:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
units.rightText: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.

units.leftText: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
units.rightText: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

units.leftText: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
units.rightText: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

units.leftText: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
units.rightText: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

units.leftText: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
units.rightText: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

units.leftText: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
units.rightText: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.

units.leftText: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
units.rightText: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced — hailstones and coals of fire.
rightNotes: 18:12 Or bolts of lightning; also in verse 13

units.leftText: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
units.rightText: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded — hailstones and coals of fire.
rightNotes: 18:13 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts and LXX do not include —hailstones and coals of fire; see 2 Samuel 22:14|2SA 22:14*.

units.leftText: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
units.rightText: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

units.leftText: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
units.rightText: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

units.leftText: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
units.rightText: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

units.leftText: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
units.rightText: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

units.leftText: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
units.rightText: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

units.leftText: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
units.rightText: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

units.leftText: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
units.rightText: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

units.leftText: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
units.rightText: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

units.leftText: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
units.rightText: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

units.leftText: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
units.rightText: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
units.rightText: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

units.leftText: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
units.rightText: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

units.leftText: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
units.rightText: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.

units.leftText: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
units.rightText: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.

units.leftText: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
units.rightText: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.

units.leftText: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
units.rightText: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.

units.leftText: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
units.rightText: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

units.leftText: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
units.rightText: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

units.leftText: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
units.rightText: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.

units.leftText: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
units.rightText: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

units.leftText: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
units.rightText: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

units.leftText: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
units.rightText: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
rightNotes: 18:35 Or and Your help exalts me or and You stoop down to make me great

units.leftText: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
units.rightText: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.

units.leftText: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
units.rightText: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

units.leftText: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
units.rightText: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

units.leftText: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
units.rightText: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

units.leftText: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
units.rightText: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.

units.leftText: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
units.rightText: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them — to the LORD, but He did not answer.

units.leftText: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
units.rightText: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
rightNotes: 18:42 Some Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac (see also 2 Samuel 22:43|2SA 22:43*); MT I poured them out

units.leftText: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
units.rightText: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.

units.leftText: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
units.rightText: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.

units.leftText: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
units.rightText: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

units.leftText: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
units.rightText: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—

units.leftText: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
units.rightText: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,

units.leftText: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
units.rightText: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

units.leftText: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
units.rightText: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
rightNotes: 18:49 Cited in Romans 15:9|ROM 15:9*

units.leftText: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
units.rightText: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
leftNotes: 18:50 or, seed

units.leftText: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

units.leftText: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
units.rightText: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

units.leftText: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
units.rightText: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
rightNotes: 19:3 Or There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard

units.leftText: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
units.rightText: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
rightNotes: 19:4 LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; Hebrew their measuring line
19:4 Cited in Romans 10:18|ROM 10:18*

units.leftText: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
units.rightText: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

units.leftText: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
units.rightText: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

units.leftText: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
units.rightText: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

units.leftText: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
units.rightText: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
units.rightText: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

units.leftText: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
units.rightText: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

units.leftText: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
units.rightText: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

units.leftText: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
units.rightText: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

units.leftText: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
units.rightText: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

units.leftText: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
units.rightText: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

units.leftText: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

units.leftText: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
units.rightText: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.

units.leftText: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.*
units.rightText: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah

units.leftText: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
units.rightText: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

units.leftText: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
units.rightText: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.

units.leftText: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
units.rightText: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.

units.leftText: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
units.rightText: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

units.leftText: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
units.rightText: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

units.leftText: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
units.rightText: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
rightNotes: 20:9 Or give victory to

units.leftText: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!

units.leftText: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.*
units.rightText: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

units.leftText: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
units.rightText: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

units.leftText: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
units.rightText: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.

units.leftText: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
units.rightText: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

units.leftText: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
units.rightText: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

units.leftText: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
units.rightText: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

units.leftText: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
units.rightText: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.

units.leftText: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
units.rightText: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

units.leftText: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
units.rightText: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

units.leftText: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
units.rightText: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

units.leftText: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
units.rightText: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.

units.leftText: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
units.rightText: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

units.leftText: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
rightNotes: 22:1 Cited in Matthew 27:46|MAT 27:46* and Mark 15:34

units.leftText: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
units.rightText: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.

units.leftText: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
units.rightText: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

units.leftText: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
units.rightText: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.

units.leftText: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
units.rightText: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.

units.leftText: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
units.rightText: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

units.leftText: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
units.rightText: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:

units.leftText: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
units.rightText: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
rightNotes: 22:8 Cited in Matthew 27:43|MAT 27:43*

units.leftText: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
units.rightText: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.

units.leftText: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
units.rightText: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.

units.leftText: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
units.rightText: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

units.leftText: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
units.rightText: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

units.leftText: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
units.rightText: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.

units.leftText: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
units.rightText: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.

units.leftText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
units.rightText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
rightNotes: 22:15 MT; or My mouth, a possible reading of the original Hebrew text

units.leftText: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
units.rightText: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
leftNotes: 22:16 So Dead Sea Scrolls. Masoretic Text reads, “Like a lion, they pin my hands and feet.”
rightNotes: 22:16 DSS, LXX, Vulgate, and Syriac; most MT like a lion at my hands and feet

units.leftText: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
units.rightText: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.

units.leftText: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
units.rightText: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
rightNotes: 22:18 Cited in John 19:24|JHN 19:24*; see also Matthew 27:35, Mark 15:24, and Luke 23:34

units.leftText: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

units.leftText: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
units.rightText: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.

units.leftText: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
units.rightText: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!

units.leftText: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
units.rightText: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
rightNotes: 22:22 LXX I will sing Your praises in the assembly; cited in Hebrews 2:12|HEB 2:12*.

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
units.rightText: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!

units.leftText: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
units.rightText: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.

units.leftText: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
units.rightText: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.

units.leftText: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
units.rightText: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

units.leftText: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
units.rightText: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

units.leftText: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
units.rightText: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

units.leftText: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
units.rightText: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.

units.leftText: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
units.rightText: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.

units.leftText: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
units.rightText: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn — all that He has done.

units.leftText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
rightNotes: 23:1 See Revelation 7:17|REV 7:17*.

units.leftText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
units.rightText: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.

units.leftText: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
units.rightText: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

units.leftText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
units.rightText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
rightNotes: 23:4 Or the valley of deep darkness

units.leftText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
units.rightText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

units.leftText: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
units.rightText: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
rightNotes: 23:6 Literally for a length of days

units.leftText: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
rightNotes: 24:1 Cited in 1 Corinthians 10:26|1CO 10:26*

units.leftText: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
units.rightText: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

units.leftText: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
units.rightText: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

units.leftText: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
units.rightText: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
rightNotes: 24:4 Or to falsehood or to vanity

units.leftText: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
units.rightText: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

units.leftText: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.*
units.rightText: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
rightNotes: 24:6 LXX, Syriac, and two Hebrew manuscripts; MT who seek your face, O Jacob

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

units.leftText: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
units.rightText: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

units.leftText: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.*
units.rightText: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts — He is the King of Glory. Selah

units.leftText: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
units.rightText: Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
rightNotes: 25:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
units.rightText: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

units.leftText: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
units.rightText: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.

units.leftText: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
units.rightText: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

units.leftText: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
units.rightText: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

units.leftText: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
units.rightText: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.

units.leftText: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
units.rightText: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.

units.leftText: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
units.rightText: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.

units.leftText: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
units.rightText: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.

units.leftText: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
units.rightText: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

units.leftText: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
units.rightText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

units.leftText: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
units.rightText: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.

units.leftText: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
units.rightText: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

units.leftText: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
units.rightText: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.

units.leftText: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
units.rightText: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.

units.leftText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
units.rightText: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

units.leftText: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
units.rightText: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.

units.leftText: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
units.rightText: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

units.leftText: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
units.rightText: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.

units.leftText: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
units.rightText: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

units.leftText: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
units.rightText: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
rightNotes: 25:21 Or because my hope is in You; LXX because I wait for You, O Lord

units.leftText: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
units.rightText: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.

units.leftText: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
units.rightText: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

units.leftText: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
units.rightText: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
rightNotes: 26:2 Hebrew my kidneys

units.leftText: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
units.rightText: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

units.leftText: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
units.rightText: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.

units.leftText: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
units.rightText: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.

units.leftText: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
units.rightText: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,

units.leftText: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
units.rightText: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
