units.leftText: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
units.rightText: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.

units.leftText: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
units.rightText: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,

units.leftText: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
units.rightText: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

units.leftText: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
units.rightText: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.

units.leftText: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
units.rightText: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.

units.leftText: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
units.rightText: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?

units.leftText: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
units.rightText: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

units.leftText: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
units.rightText: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.

units.leftText: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
units.rightText: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.

units.leftText: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
units.rightText: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.

units.leftText: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
units.rightText: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

units.leftText: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
units.rightText: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.

units.leftText: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
units.rightText: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

units.leftText: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
units.rightText: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.

units.leftText: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
units.rightText: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

units.leftText: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
units.rightText: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

units.leftText: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
units.rightText: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

units.leftText: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

units.leftText: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
units.rightText: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!

units.leftText: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
units.rightText: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.

units.leftText: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
units.rightText: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
rightNotes: 28:2 Or Your innermost sanctuary or Your Most Holy Place

units.leftText: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
units.rightText: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.

units.leftText: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
units.rightText: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.

units.leftText: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
units.rightText: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
units.rightText: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

units.leftText: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
units.rightText: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

units.leftText: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
units.rightText: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
rightNotes: 29:1 Or sons of God or sons of might

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
units.rightText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
rightNotes: 29:2 Or in holy attire

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

units.leftText: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
units.rightText: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
rightNotes: 29:6 That is, Mount Hermon

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
rightNotes: 29:9 Or LORD makes the deer to calve

units.leftText: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
units.rightText: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

units.leftText: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
units.rightText: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

units.leftText: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
units.rightText: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

units.leftText: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
units.rightText: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

units.leftText: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
units.rightText: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
leftNotes: 30:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
rightNotes: 30:4 Or and praise the memorial of His holiness; see Exodus 3:15|EXO 3:15*.

units.leftText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
units.rightText: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

units.leftText: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
units.rightText: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

units.leftText: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
units.rightText: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

units.leftText: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
units.rightText: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

units.leftText: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
units.rightText: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
rightNotes: 30:9 Or in my destruction
30:9 Or to corruption

units.leftText: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
units.rightText: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”

units.leftText: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
units.rightText: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

units.leftText: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
units.rightText: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.

units.leftText: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

units.leftText: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
units.rightText: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

units.leftText: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
units.rightText: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.

units.leftText: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
units.rightText: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.

units.leftText: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
units.rightText: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
rightNotes: 31:5 Cited in Luke 23:46|LUK 23:46*

units.leftText: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
units.rightText: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
rightNotes: 31:6 MT; one Hebrew manuscript, LXX, and Syriac You hate

units.leftText: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
units.rightText: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

units.leftText: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
units.rightText: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.

units.leftText: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
units.rightText: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

units.leftText: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
units.rightText: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

units.leftText: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
units.rightText: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends — they flee when they see me on the street.

units.leftText: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
units.rightText: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.

units.leftText: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
units.rightText: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

units.leftText: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
units.rightText: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

units.leftText: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
units.rightText: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

units.leftText: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
units.rightText: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
units.rightText: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
leftNotes: 31:17 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
units.rightText: May lying lips be silenced — lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

units.leftText: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
units.rightText: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

units.leftText: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
units.rightText: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

units.leftText: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.

units.leftText: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
units.rightText: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.

units.leftText: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
units.rightText: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

units.leftText: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
units.rightText: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

units.leftText: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
units.rightText: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
rightNotes: 32:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.
32:1 LXX Blessed is he whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered; cited in Romans 4:7|ROM 4:7*

units.leftText: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
rightNotes: 32:2 LXX Blessed is the man whose sin the LORD does not count against him; cited in Romans 4:8|ROM 4:8*

units.leftText: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
units.rightText: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.

units.leftText: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.*
units.rightText: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
rightNotes: 32:4 Or my vitality was turned

units.leftText: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.*
units.rightText: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

units.leftText: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
units.rightText: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.

units.leftText: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.*
units.rightText: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

units.leftText: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
units.rightText: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.

units.leftText: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
units.rightText: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.

units.leftText: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
units.rightText: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.

units.leftText: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
units.rightText: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

units.leftText: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
units.rightText: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
units.rightText: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

units.leftText: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
units.rightText: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

units.leftText: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
units.rightText: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.

units.leftText: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
units.rightText: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.

units.leftText: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
units.rightText: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

units.leftText: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
units.rightText: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

units.leftText: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
units.rightText: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.

units.leftText: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
units.rightText: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

units.leftText: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
units.rightText: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.

units.leftText: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
units.rightText: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.

units.leftText: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
units.rightText: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!

units.leftText: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
units.rightText: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

units.leftText: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
units.rightText: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.

units.leftText: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
units.rightText: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.

units.leftText: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
units.rightText: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.

units.leftText: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
units.rightText: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
units.rightText: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

units.leftText: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
units.rightText: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

units.leftText: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
units.rightText: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

units.leftText: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
units.rightText: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.

units.leftText: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.

units.leftText: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
units.rightText: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
leftNotes: 34:1 Psalm 34 is an acrostic poem, with each verse starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
rightNotes: 34:1 Abimelech is another name for Achish; see 1 Samuel 21–29 and 1 Kings 2:39|1KI 2:39*.
34:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
units.rightText: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

units.leftText: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
units.rightText: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

units.leftText: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
units.rightText: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

units.leftText: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
units.rightText: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.

units.leftText: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
units.rightText: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

units.leftText: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
units.rightText: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

units.leftText: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
units.rightText: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

units.leftText: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
units.rightText: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

units.leftText: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
units.rightText: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

units.leftText: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
units.rightText: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

units.leftText: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
units.rightText: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?

units.leftText: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
units.rightText: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.

units.leftText: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
units.rightText: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

units.leftText: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
units.rightText: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
rightNotes: 34:15 LXX to their prayer

units.leftText: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
units.rightText: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.

units.leftText: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
units.rightText: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

units.leftText: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
units.rightText: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

units.leftText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
units.rightText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

units.leftText: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
units.rightText: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
rightNotes: 34:20 Cited in John 19:36|JHN 19:36*

units.leftText: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
units.rightText: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.

units.leftText: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
units.rightText: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.

units.leftText: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
units.rightText: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

units.leftText: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
units.rightText: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

units.leftText: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
units.rightText: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
rightNotes: 35:3 Or and close the way

units.leftText: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
units.rightText: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

units.leftText: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
units.rightText: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.

units.leftText: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
units.rightText: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.

units.leftText: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
units.rightText: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

units.leftText: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
units.rightText: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.

units.leftText: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
units.rightText: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.

units.leftText: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
units.rightText: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”

units.leftText: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
units.rightText: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.

units.leftText: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
units.rightText: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

units.leftText: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
units.rightText: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
rightNotes: 35:13 Literally returned to my bosom

units.leftText: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
units.rightText: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.

units.leftText: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
units.rightText: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.

units.leftText: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
units.rightText: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
rightNotes: 35:16 Or Like a godless circle of mockers,

units.leftText: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
units.rightText: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

units.leftText: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
units.rightText: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

units.leftText: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
units.rightText: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.

units.leftText: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
units.rightText: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.

units.leftText: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
units.rightText: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”

units.leftText: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
units.rightText: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.

units.leftText: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
units.rightText: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!

units.leftText: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
units.rightText: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.

units.leftText: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
units.rightText: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
units.rightText: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.

units.leftText: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
units.rightText: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

units.leftText: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
units.rightText: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

units.leftText: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
rightNotes: 36:1 Cited in Romans 3:18|ROM 3:18*

units.leftText: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
units.rightText: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

units.leftText: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
units.rightText: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

units.leftText: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
units.rightText: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

units.leftText: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
units.rightText: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

units.leftText: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
units.rightText: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

units.leftText: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
units.rightText: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

units.leftText: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
units.rightText: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

units.leftText: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
units.rightText: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

units.leftText: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
units.rightText: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

units.leftText: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
units.rightText: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

units.leftText: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
units.rightText: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.

units.leftText: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
units.rightText: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
rightNotes: 37:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each stanza beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
units.rightText: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

units.leftText: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
units.rightText: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

units.leftText: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
units.rightText: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

units.leftText: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
units.rightText: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

units.leftText: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
units.rightText: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.

units.leftText: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
units.rightText: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

units.leftText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
units.rightText: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret— it can only bring harm.

units.leftText: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
units.rightText: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

units.leftText: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
units.rightText: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

units.leftText: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
units.rightText: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
rightNotes: 37:11 Or the earth; see Matthew 5:5|MAT 5:5*.

units.leftText: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
units.rightText: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

units.leftText: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
units.rightText: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.

units.leftText: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
units.rightText: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

units.leftText: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
units.rightText: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

units.leftText: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
units.rightText: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.

units.leftText: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
units.rightText: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

units.leftText: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
units.rightText: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

units.leftText: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
units.rightText: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

units.leftText: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
units.rightText: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.

units.leftText: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
units.rightText: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.

units.leftText: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
units.rightText: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.

units.leftText: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
units.rightText: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.

units.leftText: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
units.rightText: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
rightNotes: 37:24 Or upholds him with His hand

units.leftText: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
units.rightText: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

units.leftText: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
units.rightText: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.

units.leftText: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
units.rightText: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

units.leftText: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
units.rightText: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

units.leftText: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
units.rightText: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

units.leftText: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
units.rightText: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

units.leftText: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
units.rightText: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.

units.leftText: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
units.rightText: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,

units.leftText: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
units.rightText: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.

units.leftText: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
units.rightText: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

units.leftText: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
units.rightText: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,

units.leftText: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
units.rightText: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.

units.leftText: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
units.rightText: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
rightNotes: 37:37 Or for there is a future for the man of peace

units.leftText: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
units.rightText: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

units.leftText: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
units.rightText: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

units.leftText: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
units.rightText: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.

units.leftText: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

units.leftText: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
units.rightText: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

units.leftText: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
units.rightText: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

units.leftText: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
units.rightText: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

units.leftText: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
units.rightText: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

units.leftText: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
units.rightText: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

units.leftText: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
units.rightText: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

units.leftText: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
units.rightText: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

units.leftText: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
units.rightText: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

units.leftText: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
units.rightText: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

units.leftText: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
units.rightText: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

units.leftText: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
units.rightText: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

units.leftText: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
units.rightText: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

units.leftText: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
units.rightText: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

units.leftText: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
units.rightText: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

units.leftText: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
units.rightText: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me — those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

units.leftText: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
units.rightText: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

units.leftText: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
units.rightText: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

units.leftText: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
units.rightText: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
rightNotes: 38:19 One DSS manuscript; MT My enemies are vigorous and strong

units.leftText: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
units.rightText: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

units.leftText: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
units.rightText: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

units.leftText: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
units.rightText: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

units.leftText: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”

units.leftText: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
units.rightText: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.

units.leftText: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
units.rightText: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:

units.leftText: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
units.rightText: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.

units.leftText: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.*
units.rightText: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah

units.leftText: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
units.rightText: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.

units.leftText: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
units.rightText: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.

units.leftText: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
units.rightText: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.

units.leftText: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
units.rightText: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.

units.leftText: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
units.rightText: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.

units.leftText: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.*
units.rightText: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

units.leftText: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.

units.leftText: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
units.rightText: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”

units.leftText: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

units.leftText: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
units.rightText: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

units.leftText: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
units.rightText: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
rightNotes: 40:4 Or who turn aside to false gods or who run after lies

units.leftText: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
units.rightText: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us — none can compare to You — if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

units.leftText: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
units.rightText: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
rightNotes: 40:6 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts but a body You prepared for me

units.leftText: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
units.rightText: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come — it is written about me in the scroll:

units.leftText: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
units.rightText: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
rightNotes: 40:8 Cited in Hebrews 10:5–7|HEB 10:5-7*

units.leftText: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
units.rightText: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.

units.leftText: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
units.rightText: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

units.leftText: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
units.rightText: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

units.leftText: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
units.rightText: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

units.leftText: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
units.rightText: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
units.rightText: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

units.leftText: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
units.rightText: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

units.leftText: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
units.rightText: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”

units.leftText: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
units.rightText: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

units.leftText: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.

units.leftText: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
units.rightText: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.

units.leftText: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
units.rightText: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.

units.leftText: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
units.rightText: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

units.leftText: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
units.rightText: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”

units.leftText: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
units.rightText: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.

units.leftText: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
units.rightText: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:

units.leftText: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
units.rightText: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

units.leftText: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
units.rightText: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
rightNotes: 41:9 Cited in John 13:18|JHN 13:18*

units.leftText: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.

units.leftText: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
units.rightText: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

units.leftText: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
units.rightText: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

units.leftText: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
leftNotes: 42:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים*” (Elohim).
rightNotes: 42:1 In many Hebrew manuscripts Psalms 42 and 43 constitute one psalm. Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
units.rightText: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
rightNotes: 42:2 Or and see the face of God?

units.leftText: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
units.rightText: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

units.leftText: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
units.rightText: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
units.rightText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

units.leftText: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
units.rightText: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon — even from Mount Mizar.

units.leftText: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
units.rightText: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

units.leftText: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
units.rightText: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
leftNotes: 42:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
units.rightText: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

units.leftText: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
units.rightText: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
units.rightText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

units.leftText: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
units.rightText: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.

units.leftText: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
units.rightText: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?

units.leftText: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
units.rightText: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.

units.leftText: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
units.rightText: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
units.rightText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

units.leftText: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
rightNotes: 44:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
units.rightText: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.

units.leftText: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
units.rightText: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

units.leftText: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
units.rightText: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.

units.leftText: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
units.rightText: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.

units.leftText: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
units.rightText: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
rightNotes: 44:6 Or give me victory; similarly in verse 7

units.leftText: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
units.rightText: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.

units.leftText: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.*
units.rightText: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah

units.leftText: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
units.rightText: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.

units.leftText: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
units.rightText: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.

units.leftText: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
units.rightText: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.

units.leftText: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
units.rightText: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.

units.leftText: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
units.rightText: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.

units.leftText: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
units.rightText: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
rightNotes: 44:14 Literally a shaking of the head

units.leftText: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
units.rightText: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,

units.leftText: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
units.rightText: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.

units.leftText: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
units.rightText: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.

units.leftText: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
units.rightText: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.

units.leftText: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
units.rightText: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
rightNotes: 44:19 Or serpents or dragons

units.leftText: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
units.rightText: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

units.leftText: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
units.rightText: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?

units.leftText: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
units.rightText: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
rightNotes: 44:22 Cited in Romans 8:36|ROM 8:36*

units.leftText: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
units.rightText: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
leftNotes: 44:23 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
units.rightText: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?

units.leftText: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
units.rightText: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.

units.leftText: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
units.rightText: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
rightNotes: 45:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.
45:1 Or King; here and throughout Psalm 45

units.leftText: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
units.rightText: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.

units.leftText: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
units.rightText: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.

units.leftText: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
units.rightText: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

units.leftText: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
units.rightText: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.

units.leftText: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
units.rightText: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

units.leftText: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
units.rightText: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
rightNotes: 45:7 Cited in Hebrews 1:8–9|HEB 1:8-9*

units.leftText: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
units.rightText: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.

units.leftText: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
units.rightText: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.

units.leftText: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
units.rightText: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,

units.leftText: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
units.rightText: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.

units.leftText: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
units.rightText: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

units.leftText: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
units.rightText: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.

units.leftText: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
units.rightText: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.

units.leftText: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
units.rightText: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

units.leftText: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
units.rightText: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

units.leftText: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
units.rightText: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.

units.leftText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
rightNotes: 46:1 Alamothis probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:20|1CH 15:20*.

units.leftText: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
units.rightText: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,

units.leftText: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.*
units.rightText: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah

units.leftText: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
units.rightText: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

units.leftText: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
units.rightText: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.

units.leftText: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
units.rightText: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.*
units.rightText: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

units.leftText: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
units.rightText: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.

units.leftText: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
units.rightText: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
rightNotes: 46:9 Or chariots

units.leftText: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
units.rightText: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.*
