units.rightText: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.

units.leftText: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
units.rightText: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.

units.leftText: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
units.rightText: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.

units.leftText: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
units.rightText: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
units.rightText: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

units.leftText: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
units.rightText: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

units.leftText: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
units.rightText: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.

units.leftText: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
units.rightText: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

units.leftText: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
units.rightText: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

units.leftText: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
units.rightText: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.

units.leftText: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
units.rightText: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.

units.leftText: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
units.rightText: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

units.leftText: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
units.rightText: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

units.leftText: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
units.rightText: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.

units.leftText: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
units.rightText: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

units.leftText: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
units.rightText: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,

units.leftText: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
units.rightText: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,

units.leftText: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
units.rightText: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.

units.leftText: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
units.rightText: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

units.leftText: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
units.rightText: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.

units.leftText: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
units.rightText: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness — I will not lie to David —

units.leftText: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
units.rightText: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,

units.leftText: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.*
units.rightText: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah

units.leftText: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
units.rightText: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.

units.leftText: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
units.rightText: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.

units.leftText: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
units.rightText: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.

units.leftText: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
units.rightText: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.

units.leftText: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
units.rightText: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.

units.leftText: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
units.rightText: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.

units.leftText: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
units.rightText: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

units.leftText: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.*
units.rightText: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah

units.leftText: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
units.rightText: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?

units.leftText: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
units.rightText: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!

units.leftText: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.*
units.rightText: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
leftNotes: 89:48 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
units.rightText: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?

units.leftText: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
units.rightText: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people —

units.leftText: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
units.rightText: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.

units.leftText: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
units.rightText: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
leftNotes: 90:1 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
units.rightText: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

units.leftText: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
units.rightText: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

units.leftText: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
units.rightText: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
rightNotes: 90:4 See 2 Peter 3:8|2PE 3:8*.

units.leftText: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
units.rightText: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—

units.leftText: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
units.rightText: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

units.leftText: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
units.rightText: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

units.leftText: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
units.rightText: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

units.leftText: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
units.rightText: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

units.leftText: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
units.rightText: The length of our days is seventy years — or eighty if we are strong — yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

units.leftText: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
units.rightText: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

units.leftText: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
units.rightText: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

units.leftText: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
units.rightText: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
leftNotes: 90:13 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
units.rightText: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

units.leftText: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
units.rightText: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

units.leftText: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
units.rightText: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

units.leftText: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
units.rightText: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
rightNotes: 90:17 Or beauty

units.leftText: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
units.rightText: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
rightNotes: 91:1 Hebrew Shaddai

units.leftText: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
units.rightText: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

units.leftText: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
units.rightText: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

units.leftText: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
units.rightText: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

units.leftText: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
units.rightText: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

units.leftText: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
units.rightText: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

units.leftText: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
units.rightText: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.

units.leftText: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
units.rightText: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.

units.leftText: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
units.rightText: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—

units.leftText: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
units.rightText: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

units.leftText: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
units.rightText: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

units.leftText: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
units.rightText: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
rightNotes: 91:12 Cited in Matthew 4:6|MAT 4:6* and Luke 4:10–11

units.leftText: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
units.rightText: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.

units.leftText: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
units.rightText: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.

units.leftText: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
units.rightText: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

units.leftText: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
units.rightText: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”

units.leftText: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
units.rightText: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,

units.leftText: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
units.rightText: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night

units.leftText: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
units.rightText: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

units.leftText: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
units.rightText: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

units.leftText: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
units.rightText: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

units.leftText: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
units.rightText: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,

units.leftText: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
units.rightText: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

units.leftText: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!

units.leftText: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
units.rightText: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

units.leftText: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
units.rightText: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

units.leftText: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
units.rightText: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
rightNotes: 92:11 Or my ears hear evildoers when they rise against me

units.leftText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
units.rightText: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

units.leftText: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
units.rightText: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

units.leftText: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
units.rightText: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,

units.leftText: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
units.rightText: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

units.leftText: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
units.rightText: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

units.leftText: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
units.rightText: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

units.leftText: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
units.rightText: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

units.leftText: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
units.rightText: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

units.leftText: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
units.rightText: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.

units.leftText: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
units.rightText: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
leftNotes: 94:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
units.rightText: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

units.leftText: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
units.rightText: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

units.leftText: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
units.rightText: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.

units.leftText: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
units.rightText: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

units.leftText: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
units.rightText: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

units.leftText: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
units.rightText: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
leftNotes: 94:7 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
units.rightText: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

units.leftText: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
units.rightText: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

units.leftText: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
units.rightText: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

units.leftText: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
units.rightText: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
rightNotes: 94:11 Cited in 1 Corinthians 3:20|1CO 3:20*

units.leftText: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
units.rightText: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
leftNotes: 94:12 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
units.rightText: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

units.leftText: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
units.rightText: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.

units.leftText: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
units.rightText: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

units.leftText: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
units.rightText: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

units.leftText: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
units.rightText: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

units.leftText: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
units.rightText: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.

units.leftText: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
units.rightText: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.

units.leftText: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
units.rightText: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally — one devising mischief by decree?

units.leftText: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
units.rightText: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
rightNotes: 94:21 Or condemn innocent blood

units.leftText: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
units.rightText: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.

units.leftText: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
units.rightText: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.

units.leftText: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
units.rightText: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!

units.leftText: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
units.rightText: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.

units.leftText: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
units.rightText: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

units.leftText: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
units.rightText: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.

units.leftText: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
units.rightText: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

units.leftText: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
units.rightText: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.

units.leftText: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
units.rightText: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,

units.leftText: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
units.rightText: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
rightNotes: 95:8 LXX as you did in the rebellion; Meribah means quarreling; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*; cited in Hebrews 3:15 and Hebrews 4:7.
95:8 LXX in the day of testing in the wilderness; Massah means testing; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.

units.leftText: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
units.rightText: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.

units.leftText: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
units.rightText: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
rightNotes: 95:10 LXX They always go astray in the heart

units.leftText: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
units.rightText: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
rightNotes: 95:11 Cited in Hebrews 3:7–11|HEB 3:7-11*, Hebrews 4:3, and Hebrews 4:5

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.

units.leftText: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
units.rightText: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.

units.leftText: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
units.rightText: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.

units.leftText: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
units.rightText: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.

units.leftText: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
units.rightText: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
units.rightText: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
units.rightText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.

units.leftText: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
units.rightText: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

units.leftText: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
units.rightText: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

units.leftText: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
units.rightText: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.

units.leftText: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
units.rightText: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest

units.leftText: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
units.rightText: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
units.rightText: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.

units.leftText: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
units.rightText: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.

units.leftText: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
units.rightText: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

units.leftText: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
units.rightText: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.

units.leftText: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
units.rightText: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

units.leftText: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
units.rightText: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.

units.leftText: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
units.rightText: All worshipers of images are put to shame — those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
leftNotes: 97:7 LXX reads “angels” instead of “gods”.

units.leftText: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
units.rightText: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.

units.leftText: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
units.rightText: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

units.leftText: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
units.rightText: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

units.leftText: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
units.rightText: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
rightNotes: 97:11 One Hebrew manuscript, LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; most Hebrew manuscripts Light is sown

units.leftText: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
units.rightText: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
units.rightText: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.

units.leftText: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
units.rightText: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.

units.leftText: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
units.rightText: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

units.leftText: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
units.rightText: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth — let your cry ring out, and sing praises!

units.leftText: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
units.rightText: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.

units.leftText: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
units.rightText: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.

units.leftText: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
units.rightText: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.

units.leftText: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
units.rightText: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy

units.leftText: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
units.rightText: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
units.rightText: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

units.leftText: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
units.rightText: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.

units.leftText: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
units.rightText: Let them praise Your great and awesome name — He is holy!
rightNotes: 99:3 Or it is holy!

units.leftText: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
units.rightText: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
rightNotes: 99:4 Or The might of the King loves justice.

units.leftText: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
units.rightText: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

units.leftText: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
units.rightText: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.

units.leftText: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
units.rightText: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.

units.leftText: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
units.rightText: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.

units.leftText: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
units.rightText: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

units.leftText: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
units.rightText: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.

units.leftText: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
units.rightText: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.

units.leftText: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
units.rightText: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
rightNotes: 100:3 Or and not we ourselves

units.leftText: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
units.rightText: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.

units.leftText: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
units.rightText: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.

units.leftText: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

units.leftText: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
units.rightText: I will ponder the way that is blameless — when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.

units.leftText: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
units.rightText: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

units.leftText: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
units.rightText: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.

units.leftText: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
units.rightText: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.

units.leftText: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
units.rightText: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.

units.leftText: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
units.rightText: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.

units.leftText: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
units.rightText: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

units.leftText: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
units.rightText: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
leftNotes: 102:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
units.rightText: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.

units.leftText: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
units.rightText: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.

units.leftText: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
units.rightText: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.

units.leftText: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
units.rightText: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.

units.leftText: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
units.rightText: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

units.leftText: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
units.rightText: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.

units.leftText: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
units.rightText: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.

units.leftText: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
units.rightText: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears

units.leftText: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
units.rightText: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.

units.leftText: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
units.rightText: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.

units.leftText: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
units.rightText: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.

units.leftText: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
units.rightText: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor — the appointed time has come.

units.leftText: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
units.rightText: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.

units.leftText: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
units.rightText: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.

units.leftText: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
units.rightText: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.

units.leftText: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
units.rightText: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.

units.leftText: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
units.rightText: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
leftNotes: 102:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
units.rightText: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth

units.leftText: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
units.rightText: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,

units.leftText: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
units.rightText: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,

units.leftText: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
units.rightText: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.

units.leftText: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
units.rightText: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.

units.leftText: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
units.rightText: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.

units.leftText: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
units.rightText: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

units.leftText: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
units.rightText: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.

units.leftText: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
units.rightText: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
rightNotes: 102:27 Cited in Hebrews 1:10–12|HEB 1:10-12*

units.leftText: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
units.rightText: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
units.rightText: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
units.rightText: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds —

units.leftText: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
units.rightText: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

units.leftText: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
units.rightText: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,

units.leftText: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
units.rightText: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

units.leftText: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
units.rightText: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

units.leftText: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
units.rightText: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
units.rightText: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

units.leftText: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
units.rightText: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.

units.leftText: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
units.rightText: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.

units.leftText: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
units.rightText: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

units.leftText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
units.rightText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

units.leftText: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
units.rightText: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

units.leftText: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
units.rightText: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.

units.leftText: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
units.rightText: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;

units.leftText: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
units.rightText: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.

units.leftText: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
units.rightText: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children —

units.leftText: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
units.rightText: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.

units.leftText: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
units.rightText: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
units.rightText: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
units.rightText: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
units.rightText: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
units.rightText: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
leftNotes: 104:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
units.rightText: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,

units.leftText: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
units.rightText: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.

units.leftText: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
units.rightText: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
leftNotes: 104:4 or, angels
rightNotes: 104:4 LXX He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.Cited in Hebrews 1:7|HEB 1:7*

units.leftText: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
units.rightText: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.

units.leftText: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
units.rightText: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

units.leftText: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
units.rightText: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away —

units.leftText: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
units.rightText: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them —

units.leftText: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
units.rightText: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.

units.leftText: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
units.rightText: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.

units.leftText: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
units.rightText: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

units.leftText: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
units.rightText: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.

units.leftText: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
units.rightText: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.

units.leftText: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
units.rightText: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:

units.leftText: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
units.rightText: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

units.leftText: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
units.rightText: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

units.leftText: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
units.rightText: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
rightNotes: 104:17 Or pines or junipers or firs

units.leftText: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
units.rightText: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
rightNotes: 104:18 Or the coneys or the hyraxes

units.leftText: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
units.rightText: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.

units.leftText: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
units.rightText: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.

units.leftText: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
units.rightText: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

units.leftText: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
units.rightText: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.

units.leftText: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
units.rightText: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.

units.leftText: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
units.rightText: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

units.leftText: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
units.rightText: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.

units.leftText: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
units.rightText: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.

units.leftText: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
units.rightText: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.

units.leftText: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
units.rightText: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

units.leftText: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
units.rightText: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.

units.leftText: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
units.rightText: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
rightNotes: 104:30 Or breath

units.leftText: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
units.rightText: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.

units.leftText: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
units.rightText: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.

units.leftText: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
units.rightText: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

units.leftText: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
units.rightText: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.

units.leftText: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 104:35 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
104:35 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 104:35 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
leftNotes: 105:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
units.rightText: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

units.leftText: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
units.rightText: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

units.leftText: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
units.rightText: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

units.leftText: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
units.rightText: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

units.leftText: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
units.rightText: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

units.leftText: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
units.rightText: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

units.leftText: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
units.rightText: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

units.leftText: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
units.rightText: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.

units.leftText: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
units.rightText: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

units.leftText: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
units.rightText: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

units.leftText: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
units.rightText: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,

units.leftText: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
units.rightText: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

units.leftText: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
units.rightText: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

units.leftText: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
units.rightText: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”

units.leftText: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
units.rightText: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
rightNotes: 105:16 Hebrew staff

units.leftText: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
units.rightText: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.

units.leftText: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
units.rightText: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,

units.leftText: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
units.rightText: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.

units.leftText: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
units.rightText: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

units.leftText: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
units.rightText: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,

units.leftText: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
units.rightText: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
rightNotes: 105:22 LXX and Syriac; MT to bind

units.leftText: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
units.rightText: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.

units.leftText: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
units.rightText: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,

units.leftText: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
units.rightText: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.

units.leftText: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
units.rightText: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

units.leftText: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
units.rightText: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

units.leftText: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
units.rightText: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
rightNotes: 105:28 LXX and Syriac; Hebrew for had they not defied His words?

units.leftText: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
units.rightText: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.

units.leftText: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
units.rightText: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.

units.leftText: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
units.rightText: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.

units.leftText: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
units.rightText: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.

units.leftText: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
units.rightText: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

units.leftText: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
units.rightText: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.

units.leftText: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
units.rightText: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.

units.leftText: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
units.rightText: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.

units.leftText: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
units.rightText: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.

units.leftText: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
units.rightText: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.

units.leftText: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
units.rightText: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.

units.leftText: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
units.rightText: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

units.leftText: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
units.rightText: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

units.leftText: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
units.rightText: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.

units.leftText: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
units.rightText: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.

units.leftText: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
units.rightText: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,

units.leftText: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 105:45 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 105:45 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
leftNotes: 106:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 106:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 48

units.leftText: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
units.rightText: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
units.rightText: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.

units.leftText: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
units.rightText: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,

units.leftText: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
units.rightText: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.

units.leftText: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
units.rightText: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

units.leftText: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
units.rightText: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
rightNotes: 106:7 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verses 9 and 22

units.leftText: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
units.rightText: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.

units.leftText: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
units.rightText: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.

units.leftText: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
units.rightText: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

units.leftText: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
units.rightText: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.

units.leftText: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
units.rightText: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

units.leftText: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
units.rightText: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.

units.leftText: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
units.rightText: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.

units.leftText: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
units.rightText: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

units.leftText: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
units.rightText: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

units.leftText: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
units.rightText: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.

units.leftText: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
units.rightText: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.

units.leftText: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
units.rightText: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
rightNotes: 106:19 That is, Mount Sinai, or possibly a mountain in the range containing Mount Sinai

units.leftText: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
units.rightText: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
rightNotes: 106:20 Or their glorious God

units.leftText: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
units.rightText: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,

units.leftText: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
units.rightText: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

units.leftText: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
units.rightText: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.

units.leftText: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
units.rightText: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.

units.leftText: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
units.rightText: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

units.leftText: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
units.rightText: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,

units.leftText: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
units.rightText: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
rightNotes: 106:27 Or cast down or cause to fall

units.leftText: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
units.rightText: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.

units.leftText: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
units.rightText: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

units.leftText: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
units.rightText: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.

units.leftText: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
units.rightText: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

units.leftText: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
units.rightText: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
rightNotes: 106:32 Meribah means quarreling; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.

units.leftText: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
units.rightText: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
rightNotes: 106:33 Or they provoked His Spirit

units.leftText: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
units.rightText: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

units.leftText: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
units.rightText: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

units.leftText: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
units.rightText: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

units.leftText: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
units.rightText: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

units.leftText: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
units.rightText: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.

units.leftText: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
units.rightText: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
units.rightText: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.

units.leftText: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
units.rightText: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.

units.leftText: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
units.rightText: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.

units.leftText: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
units.rightText: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.

units.leftText: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
units.rightText: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.

units.leftText: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
units.rightText: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.

units.leftText: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
units.rightText: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.

units.leftText: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
units.rightText: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 106:48 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
leftNotes: 107:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
units.rightText: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy

units.leftText: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
units.rightText: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
rightNotes: 107:3 Hebrew north and the sea

units.leftText: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
units.rightText: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.

units.leftText: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
units.rightText: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.

units.leftText: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.

units.leftText: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
units.rightText: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

units.leftText: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
units.rightText: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

units.leftText: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
units.rightText: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,

units.leftText: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
units.rightText: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
leftNotes: 107:11 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים*” (Elohim).

units.leftText: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
units.rightText: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

units.leftText: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

units.leftText: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
units.rightText: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

units.leftText: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
units.rightText: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.

units.leftText: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
units.rightText: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.

units.leftText: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
units.rightText: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.

units.leftText: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

units.leftText: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
units.rightText: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

units.leftText: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
units.rightText: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.

units.leftText: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
units.rightText: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
