units.leftText: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
units.rightText: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.

units.leftText: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
units.rightText: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.

units.leftText: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
units.rightText: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.

units.leftText: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
units.rightText: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
rightNotes: 107:27 Or and all their wisdom was swallowed up or and they were at their wits’ end

units.leftText: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.

units.leftText: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
units.rightText: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
rightNotes: 107:29 DSS; MT their waves

units.leftText: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
units.rightText: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

units.leftText: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
units.rightText: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.

units.leftText: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
units.rightText: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,

units.leftText: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
units.rightText: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.

units.leftText: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
units.rightText: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.

units.leftText: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
units.rightText: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.

units.leftText: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
units.rightText: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.

units.leftText: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
units.rightText: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.

units.leftText: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
units.rightText: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,

units.leftText: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
units.rightText: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.

units.leftText: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
units.rightText: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.

units.leftText: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
units.rightText: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.

units.leftText: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
units.rightText: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.

units.leftText: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
units.rightText: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
rightNotes: 108:1 Or with my glory

units.leftText: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
units.rightText: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
units.rightText: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

units.leftText: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
units.rightText: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

units.leftText: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
units.rightText: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

units.leftText: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
units.rightText: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

units.leftText: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
units.rightText: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
rightNotes: 108:7 Or in His holiness

units.leftText: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
units.rightText: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

units.leftText: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
units.rightText: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

units.leftText: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
units.rightText: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

units.leftText: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
units.rightText: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

units.leftText: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
units.rightText: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

units.leftText: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
units.rightText: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

units.leftText: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.

units.leftText: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
units.rightText: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.

units.leftText: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
units.rightText: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.

units.leftText: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
units.rightText: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

units.leftText: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
units.rightText: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

units.leftText: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
units.rightText: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

units.leftText: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
units.rightText: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.

units.leftText: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
units.rightText: May his days be few; may another take his position.
rightNotes: 109:8 Cited in Acts 1:20|ACT 1:20*

units.leftText: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
units.rightText: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

units.leftText: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
units.rightText: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
rightNotes: 109:10 Hebrew; LXX may they be driven

units.leftText: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
units.rightText: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

units.leftText: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
units.rightText: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.

units.leftText: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
units.rightText: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.

units.leftText: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
units.rightText: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

units.leftText: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
units.rightText: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.

units.leftText: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
units.rightText: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.

units.leftText: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
units.rightText: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.

units.leftText: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
units.rightText: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

units.leftText: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
units.rightText: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

units.leftText: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
units.rightText: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.

units.leftText: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
units.rightText: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
leftNotes: 109:21 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
units.rightText: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.

units.leftText: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
units.rightText: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

units.leftText: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
units.rightText: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.

units.leftText: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
units.rightText: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

units.leftText: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
units.rightText: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
units.rightText: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.

units.leftText: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
units.rightText: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.

units.leftText: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
units.rightText: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

units.leftText: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
units.rightText: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.

units.leftText: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
units.rightText: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.

units.leftText: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
rightNotes: 110:1 Cited in Matthew 22:44|MAT 22:44*, Mark 12:36, Luke 20:42–43, Acts 2:34–35, and Hebrews 1:13

units.leftText: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
units.rightText: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”

units.leftText: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
units.rightText: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.

units.leftText: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
units.rightText: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
rightNotes: 110:4 Cited in Hebrews 5:6|HEB 5:6*, Hebrews 7:17, and Hebrews 7:21

units.leftText: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
units.rightText: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.

units.leftText: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
units.rightText: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.

units.leftText: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
units.rightText: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
leftNotes: 111:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 111 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
111:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 111:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD. This psalm is an acrostic poem, each line beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
units.rightText: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

units.leftText: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
units.rightText: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

units.leftText: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
units.rightText: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

units.leftText: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
units.rightText: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

units.leftText: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
units.rightText: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

units.leftText: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
units.rightText: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

units.leftText: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
units.rightText: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

units.leftText: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
units.rightText: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
units.rightText: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
leftNotes: 112:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 112 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
112:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 112:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD. This psalm is an acrostic poem, each line beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
units.rightText: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

units.leftText: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
units.rightText: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

units.leftText: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
units.rightText: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright — for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

units.leftText: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
units.rightText: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

units.leftText: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
units.rightText: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

units.leftText: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
units.rightText: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

units.leftText: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
units.rightText: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

units.leftText: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
units.rightText: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
rightNotes: 112:9 Cited in 2 Corinthians 9:9|2CO 9:9*

units.leftText: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
units.rightText: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
leftNotes: 113:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
113:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה‎ Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 113:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 9

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
units.rightText: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
units.rightText: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.

units.leftText: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
units.rightText: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.

units.leftText: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
units.rightText: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?

units.leftText: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
units.rightText: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.

units.leftText: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
units.rightText: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump

units.leftText: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
units.rightText: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.

units.leftText: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 113:9 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
units.rightText: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

units.leftText: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
units.rightText: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

units.leftText: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
units.rightText: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;

units.leftText: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
units.rightText: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

units.leftText: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
units.rightText: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,

units.leftText: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
units.rightText: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?

units.leftText: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
units.rightText: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

units.leftText: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
units.rightText: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!

units.leftText: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
units.rightText: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
leftNotes: 115:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
units.rightText: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

units.leftText: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
units.rightText: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.

units.leftText: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
units.rightText: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

units.leftText: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
units.rightText: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

units.leftText: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
units.rightText: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;

units.leftText: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
units.rightText: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
rightNotes: 115:7 Literally they cannot utter with their throat

units.leftText: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
units.rightText: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

units.leftText: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
units.rightText: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
rightNotes: 115:9 MT; many Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac O house of Israel

units.leftText: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
units.rightText: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
units.rightText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

units.leftText: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
units.rightText: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

units.leftText: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
units.rightText: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.

units.leftText: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
units.rightText: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.

units.leftText: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
units.rightText: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

units.leftText: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
units.rightText: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

units.leftText: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
units.rightText: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
leftNotes: 115:17 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah
115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 115:18 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
units.rightText: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice — my appeal for mercy.
leftNotes: 116:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
units.rightText: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

units.leftText: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
units.rightText: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
leftNotes: 116:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
units.rightText: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
units.rightText: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
units.rightText: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.

units.leftText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
units.rightText: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

units.leftText: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
units.rightText: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

units.leftText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

units.leftText: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
units.rightText: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
rightNotes: 116:10 LXX therefore I have spoken; cited in 2 Corinthians 4:13|2CO 4:13*

units.leftText: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
units.rightText: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”

units.leftText: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
units.rightText: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?

units.leftText: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
units.rightText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.

units.leftText: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
units.rightText: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.

units.leftText: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
units.rightText: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.

units.leftText: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
units.rightText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,

units.leftText: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 116:19 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 116:19 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
units.rightText: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
leftNotes: 117:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 117:1 Cited in Romans 15:11|ROM 15:11*

units.leftText: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 117:2 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 117:2 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
leftNotes: 118:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
rightNotes: 118:2 LXX the house of Israel

units.leftText: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

units.leftText: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

units.leftText: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
units.rightText: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
leftNotes: 118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah
118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
units.rightText: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
rightNotes: 118:6 Or The LORD is with me; also in verse 7; LXX The Lord is my helper
118:6 Cited in Hebrews 13:6|HEB 13:6*

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
units.rightText: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

units.leftText: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
units.rightText: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

units.leftText: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
units.rightText: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

units.leftText: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
units.rightText: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

units.leftText: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
units.rightText: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
units.rightText: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
leftNotes: 118:14 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
units.rightText: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!

units.leftText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
units.rightText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”

units.leftText: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
units.rightText: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.

units.leftText: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
units.rightText: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
leftNotes: 118:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
units.rightText: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
leftNotes: 118:19 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
units.rightText: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
units.rightText: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.

units.leftText: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
units.rightText: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
leftNotes: 118:22 Literally, head of the corner
rightNotes: 118:22 Hebrew the head of the corner; cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42*, Mark 12:10, Luke 20:17, Acts 4:11, and 1 Peter 2:7

units.leftText: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
units.rightText: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
rightNotes: 118:23 Cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42* and Mark 12:11

units.leftText: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
units.rightText: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

units.leftText: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
units.rightText: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
rightNotes: 118:25 Hebrew hosia-na, meaning save, we pray or save now; see Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 21:15, Mark 11:9, and John 12:13.

units.leftText: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
units.rightText: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
rightNotes: 118:26 Cited in Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 23:39, Mark 11:9, Luke 13:35, Luke 19:38, and John 12:13

units.leftText: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
units.rightText: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
rightNotes: 118:27 Or Join in the festal procession with boughs in hand, up to the horns of the altar.

units.leftText: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
units.rightText: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.

units.leftText: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
units.rightText: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
rightNotes: 119:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem of twenty-two stanzas, following the letters of the Hebrew alphabet; within a stanza, each verse begins with the same Hebrew letter.

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
units.rightText: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.

units.leftText: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
units.rightText: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.

units.leftText: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
units.rightText: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

units.leftText: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
units.rightText: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!

units.leftText: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
units.rightText: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
units.rightText: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
units.rightText: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me. ב BETH

units.leftText: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
units.rightText: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.

units.leftText: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
units.rightText: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

units.leftText: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
units.rightText: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

units.leftText: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
units.rightText: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.

units.leftText: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
units.rightText: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.

units.leftText: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
units.rightText: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
units.rightText: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. ג GIMEL

units.leftText: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
units.rightText: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.

units.leftText: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
units.rightText: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.

units.leftText: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
units.rightText: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.

units.leftText: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
units.rightText: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.

units.leftText: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
units.rightText: You rebuke the arrogant — the cursed who stray from Your commandments.

units.leftText: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
units.rightText: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

units.leftText: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
units.rightText: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.

units.leftText: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
units.rightText: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. ד DALETH

units.leftText: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
units.rightText: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.

units.leftText: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
units.rightText: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.

units.leftText: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
units.rightText: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

units.leftText: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
units.rightText: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.

units.leftText: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
units.rightText: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.

units.leftText: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
units.rightText: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.

units.leftText: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
units.rightText: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart. ה HE

units.leftText: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
units.rightText: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
rightNotes: 119:33 Or keep them as my reward

units.leftText: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
units.rightText: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.

units.leftText: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
units.rightText: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.

units.leftText: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
units.rightText: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.

units.leftText: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
units.rightText: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
rightNotes: 119:37 Two MT manuscripts and DSS; most MT manuscripts in Your way

units.leftText: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
units.rightText: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.

units.leftText: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
units.rightText: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.

units.leftText: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
units.rightText: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness. ו WAW

units.leftText: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.

units.leftText: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
units.rightText: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.

units.leftText: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
units.rightText: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.

units.leftText: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
units.rightText: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.

units.leftText: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
units.rightText: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.

units.leftText: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
units.rightText: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
units.rightText: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.

units.leftText: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
units.rightText: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes. ז ZAYIN

units.leftText: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
units.rightText: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.

units.leftText: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
units.rightText: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

units.leftText: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
units.rightText: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.

units.leftText: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
units.rightText: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.

units.leftText: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
units.rightText: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.

units.leftText: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
units.rightText: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.

units.leftText: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
units.rightText: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.

units.leftText: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
units.rightText: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts. ח HETH

units.leftText: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
units.rightText: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.

units.leftText: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
units.rightText: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.

units.leftText: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
units.rightText: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.

units.leftText: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
units.rightText: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.

units.leftText: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
units.rightText: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.

units.leftText: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
units.rightText: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

units.leftText: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
units.rightText: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes. ט TETH

units.leftText: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
units.rightText: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

units.leftText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
units.rightText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.

units.leftText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
units.rightText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.

units.leftText: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
units.rightText: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.

units.leftText: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
units.rightText: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
rightNotes: 119:70 Or fat

units.leftText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
units.rightText: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.

units.leftText: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
units.rightText: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. י YODH

units.leftText: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
units.rightText: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.

units.leftText: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
units.rightText: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.

units.leftText: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
units.rightText: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

units.leftText: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.

units.leftText: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
units.rightText: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.

units.leftText: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
units.rightText: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.

units.leftText: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
units.rightText: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.

units.leftText: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
units.rightText: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame. כ KAPH

units.leftText: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
units.rightText: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.

units.leftText: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
units.rightText: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”

units.leftText: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
units.rightText: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.

units.leftText: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
units.rightText: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
rightNotes: 119:84 Or How many are the days of Your servant?

units.leftText: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
units.rightText: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.

units.leftText: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
units.rightText: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause— help me!

units.leftText: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
units.rightText: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.

units.leftText: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
units.rightText: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth. ל LAMEDH

units.leftText: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
units.rightText: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.

units.leftText: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
units.rightText: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.

units.leftText: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
units.rightText: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
rightNotes: 119:91 Or They stand this day according to Your ordinances

units.leftText: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
units.rightText: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

units.leftText: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
units.rightText: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.

units.leftText: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
units.rightText: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.

units.leftText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
units.rightText: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.

units.leftText: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
units.rightText: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit. מ MEM

units.leftText: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
units.rightText: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.

units.leftText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
units.rightText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.

units.leftText: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
units.rightText: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.

units.leftText: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
units.rightText: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.

units.leftText: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
units.rightText: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.

units.leftText: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
units.rightText: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.

units.leftText: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
units.rightText: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!

units.leftText: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
units.rightText: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN

units.leftText: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
units.rightText: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

units.leftText: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.
units.rightText: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.

units.leftText: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
units.rightText: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

units.leftText: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
units.rightText: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.

units.leftText: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
units.rightText: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

units.leftText: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
units.rightText: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

units.leftText: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
units.rightText: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end. ס SAMEKH

units.leftText: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
units.rightText: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.

units.leftText: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
units.rightText: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.

units.leftText: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
units.rightText: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.

units.leftText: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
units.rightText: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.

units.leftText: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
units.rightText: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.

units.leftText: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
units.rightText: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

units.leftText: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
units.rightText: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.

units.leftText: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
units.rightText: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments. ע AYIN

units.leftText: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
units.rightText: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.

units.leftText: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
units.rightText: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

units.leftText: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
units.rightText: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.

units.leftText: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
units.rightText: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

units.leftText: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
units.rightText: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.

units.leftText: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
units.rightText: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.

units.leftText: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
units.rightText: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way. פ PE

units.leftText: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
units.rightText: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.

units.leftText: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
units.rightText: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.

units.leftText: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
units.rightText: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.

units.leftText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
units.rightText: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.

units.leftText: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
units.rightText: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.

units.leftText: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
units.rightText: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

units.leftText: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
units.rightText: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed. צ TZADE

units.leftText: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
units.rightText: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.

units.leftText: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
units.rightText: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.

units.leftText: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
units.rightText: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.

units.leftText: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
units.rightText: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

units.leftText: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
units.rightText: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.

units.leftText: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
units.rightText: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

units.leftText: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
units.rightText: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.

units.leftText: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
units.rightText: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. ק KOPH

units.leftText: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.
units.rightText: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.

units.leftText: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
units.rightText: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.

units.leftText: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
units.rightText: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.

units.leftText: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
units.rightText: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.

units.leftText: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.
units.rightText: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.

units.leftText: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
units.rightText: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.

units.leftText: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
units.rightText: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.

units.leftText: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
units.rightText: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever. ר RESH

units.leftText: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
units.rightText: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.

units.leftText: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
units.rightText: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.

units.leftText: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
units.rightText: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.

units.leftText: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
units.rightText: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.

units.leftText: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
units.rightText: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.

units.leftText: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
units.rightText: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.

units.leftText: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.
units.rightText: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
units.rightText: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever. ש SIN and SHIN

units.leftText: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
units.rightText: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.

units.leftText: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
units.rightText: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.

units.leftText: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
units.rightText: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.

units.leftText: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
units.rightText: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.

units.leftText: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
units.rightText: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.

units.leftText: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
units.rightText: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.

units.leftText: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
units.rightText: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You. ת TAW

units.leftText: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.
units.rightText: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.

units.leftText: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
units.rightText: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.

units.leftText: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
units.rightText: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.

units.leftText: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
units.rightText: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.

units.leftText: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
units.rightText: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.

units.leftText: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
units.rightText: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.

units.leftText: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
units.rightText: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.

units.leftText: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.

units.leftText: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
units.rightText: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

units.leftText: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
units.rightText: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?

units.leftText: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
units.rightText: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

units.leftText: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
units.rightText: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

units.leftText: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
units.rightText: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

units.leftText: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
units.rightText: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.

units.leftText: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
units.rightText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?

units.leftText: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
units.rightText: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

units.leftText: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
units.rightText: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.

units.leftText: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
units.rightText: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

units.leftText: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
units.rightText: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.

units.leftText: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
units.rightText: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

units.leftText: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
units.rightText: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.

units.leftText: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
units.rightText: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”

units.leftText: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
units.rightText: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
units.rightText: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,

units.leftText: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

units.leftText: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
units.rightText: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

units.leftText: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
units.rightText: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
rightNotes: 122:6 Or be secure

units.leftText: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
units.rightText: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
rightNotes: 122:7 Or security

units.leftText: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
units.rightText: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”

units.leftText: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
units.rightText: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.

units.leftText: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.

units.leftText: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
units.rightText: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.

units.leftText: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
units.rightText: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.

units.leftText: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
units.rightText: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.

units.leftText: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—

units.leftText: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
units.rightText: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,

units.leftText: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
units.rightText: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,

units.leftText: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
units.rightText: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,

units.leftText: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
units.rightText: then the raging waters would have swept us away.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.

units.leftText: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
units.rightText: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.

units.leftText: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
units.rightText: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

units.leftText: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

units.leftText: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
units.rightText: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
units.rightText: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.

units.leftText: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
units.rightText: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.

units.leftText: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
units.rightText: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

units.leftText: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
rightNotes: 126:1 Or brought back the captives to Zion or restored the fortunes of Zion
126:1 Or like those restored to health

units.leftText: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
units.rightText: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

units.leftText: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
units.rightText: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.

units.leftText: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
units.rightText: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
rightNotes: 126:4 Or Restore our fortunes

units.leftText: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
units.rightText: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.

units.leftText: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
units.rightText: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.

units.leftText: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.

units.leftText: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
units.rightText: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat — for He gives sleep to His beloved.

units.leftText: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
units.rightText: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.

units.leftText: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
