units.rightText: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.

units.leftText: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.

units.leftText: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!

units.leftText: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
units.rightText: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.

units.leftText: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
units.rightText: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.

units.leftText: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
units.rightText: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.

units.leftText: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
units.rightText: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

units.leftText: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
units.rightText: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!

units.leftText: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—

units.leftText: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
units.rightText: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.

units.leftText: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
units.rightText: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
units.rightText: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
units.rightText: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

units.leftText: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
units.rightText: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,

units.leftText: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
units.rightText: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.

units.leftText: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
units.rightText: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”

units.leftText: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
leftNotes: 130:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
units.rightText: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

units.leftText: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
units.rightText: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
leftNotes: 130:3 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
units.rightText: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

units.leftText: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
units.rightText: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.

units.leftText: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
units.rightText: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.

units.leftText: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
units.rightText: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

units.leftText: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
units.rightText: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.

units.leftText: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.

units.leftText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
units.rightText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

units.leftText: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
units.rightText: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
units.rightText: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,

units.leftText: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
units.rightText: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

units.leftText: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
units.rightText: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,

units.leftText: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
units.rightText: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

units.leftText: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
units.rightText: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob. ”
rightNotes: 132:5 LXX for the God of Jacob; see Acts 7:46|ACT 7:46*.

units.leftText: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
units.rightText: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
rightNotes: 132:6 Literally Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah

units.leftText: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
units.rightText: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.

units.leftText: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
units.rightText: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.

units.leftText: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
units.rightText: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.

units.leftText: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
units.rightText: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.

units.leftText: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
units.rightText: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
rightNotes: 132:11 Literally “From the fruit of your body I will set (one) on your throne.Cited in Acts 2:30|ACT 2:30*

units.leftText: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
units.rightText: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”

units.leftText: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
units.rightText: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:

units.leftText: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
units.rightText: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.

units.leftText: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
units.rightText: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.

units.leftText: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
units.rightText: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.

units.leftText: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
units.rightText: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.

units.leftText: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
units.rightText: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”

units.leftText: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

units.leftText: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
units.rightText: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.

units.leftText: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
units.rightText: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

units.leftText: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

units.leftText: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!

units.leftText: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
units.rightText: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
leftNotes: 135:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
135:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 135:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verses 3 and 21

units.leftText: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
units.rightText: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
units.rightText: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
leftNotes: 135:3 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
units.rightText: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
leftNotes: 135:4 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
units.rightText: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.

units.leftText: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
units.rightText: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.

units.leftText: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
units.rightText: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

units.leftText: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
units.rightText: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.

units.leftText: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
units.rightText: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

units.leftText: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
units.rightText: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:

units.leftText: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
units.rightText: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.

units.leftText: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
units.rightText: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.

units.leftText: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
units.rightText: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

units.leftText: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
units.rightText: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
rightNotes: 135:14 Or will judge His people; see also LXX; cited in Hebrews 10:30|HEB 10:30*.

units.leftText: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
units.rightText: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

units.leftText: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
units.rightText: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

units.leftText: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
units.rightText: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.

units.leftText: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
units.rightText: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

units.leftText: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
units.rightText: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;

units.leftText: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
units.rightText: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Blessed be the LORD from Zion — He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 135:21 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He made the great lights — His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
rightNotes: 136:13 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verse 15

units.leftText: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
rightNotes: 136:15 Hebrew shook off

units.leftText: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
units.rightText: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.

units.leftText: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
units.rightText: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

units.leftText: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
units.rightText: There on the willows we hung our harps,
rightNotes: 137:2 Or poplars

units.leftText: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
units.rightText: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”

units.leftText: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
units.rightText: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?

units.leftText: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
units.rightText: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.

units.leftText: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
units.rightText: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!

units.leftText: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
units.rightText: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”

units.leftText: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
units.rightText: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.

units.leftText: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
units.rightText: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

units.leftText: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
units.rightText: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
leftNotes: 138:1 The word elohim, used here, usually means “God” but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”.

units.leftText: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
units.rightText: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.

units.leftText: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
units.rightText: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
rightNotes: 138:3 Or You emboldened me with strength in my soul

units.leftText: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
units.rightText: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

units.leftText: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
units.rightText: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

units.leftText: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
units.rightText: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.

units.leftText: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
units.rightText: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

units.leftText: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
units.rightText: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever — do not abandon the works of Your hands.

units.leftText: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

units.leftText: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
units.rightText: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.

units.leftText: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
units.rightText: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.

units.leftText: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
units.rightText: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.

units.leftText: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
units.rightText: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.

units.leftText: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
units.rightText: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

units.leftText: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
units.rightText: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

units.leftText: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
units.rightText: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
leftNotes: 139:8 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
units.rightText: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,

units.leftText: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
units.rightText: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.

units.leftText: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
units.rightText: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—

units.leftText: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
units.rightText: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

units.leftText: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
units.rightText: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
rightNotes: 139:13 Hebrew my kidneys

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
units.rightText: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

units.leftText: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
units.rightText: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

units.leftText: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
units.rightText: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.

units.leftText: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
units.rightText: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
rightNotes: 139:17 Or How amazing are Your thoughts concerning me

units.leftText: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
units.rightText: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

units.leftText: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
units.rightText: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—

units.leftText: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
units.rightText: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
rightNotes: 139:20 Hebrew Your enemies take in vain or Your enemies bear up in vain; LXX Your enemies take Your cities in vain

units.leftText: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
units.rightText: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?

units.leftText: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
units.rightText: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.

units.leftText: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
units.rightText: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.

units.leftText: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
units.rightText: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

units.leftText: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
units.rightText: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.

units.leftText: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.*
units.rightText: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
rightNotes: 140:3 Cited in Romans 3:13|ROM 3:13*

units.leftText: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
units.rightText: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

units.leftText: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.*
units.rightText: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

units.leftText: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
units.rightText: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

units.leftText: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
units.rightText: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

units.leftText: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.*
units.rightText: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah

units.leftText: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
units.rightText: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

units.leftText: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
units.rightText: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.

units.leftText: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
units.rightText: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.

units.leftText: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
units.rightText: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

units.leftText: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
units.rightText: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

units.leftText: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.

units.leftText: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
units.rightText: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.

units.leftText: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
units.rightText: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.

units.leftText: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
units.rightText: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.

units.leftText: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
units.rightText: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.

units.leftText: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
units.rightText: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.

units.leftText: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
units.rightText: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
leftNotes: 141:7 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
units.rightText: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
rightNotes: 141:8 Or do not pour out my life or do not give me over to death

units.leftText: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
units.rightText: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.

units.leftText: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
units.rightText: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

units.leftText: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
units.rightText: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
rightNotes: 142:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
units.rightText: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.

units.leftText: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
units.rightText: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.

units.leftText: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
units.rightText: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.

units.leftText: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
units.rightText: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

units.leftText: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
units.rightText: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.

units.leftText: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
units.rightText: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.

units.leftText: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

units.leftText: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
units.rightText: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.

units.leftText: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
units.rightText: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

units.leftText: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
units.rightText: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.

units.leftText: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
units.rightText: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.

units.leftText: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.*
units.rightText: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

units.leftText: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
units.rightText: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.

units.leftText: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
units.rightText: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
units.rightText: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
rightNotes: 143:9 LXX and one Hebrew manuscript; most Hebrew manuscripts in You I take cover

units.leftText: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
units.rightText: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

units.leftText: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
units.rightText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

units.leftText: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
units.rightText: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
units.rightText: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

units.leftText: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
units.rightText: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
rightNotes: 144:2 Many Hebrew manuscripts, DSS, Syriac; most Hebrew manuscripts subdues my people

units.leftText: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
units.rightText: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?

units.leftText: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
units.rightText: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.

units.leftText: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
units.rightText: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

units.leftText: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
units.rightText: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.

units.leftText: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
units.rightText: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,

units.leftText: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
units.rightText: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.

units.leftText: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
units.rightText: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You —

units.leftText: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
units.rightText: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.

units.leftText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
units.rightText: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.

units.leftText: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
units.rightText: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.

units.leftText: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
units.rightText: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.

units.leftText: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
units.rightText: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
rightNotes: 144:14 Or Our chieftains will be firmly established

units.leftText: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
units.rightText: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.

units.leftText: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
units.rightText: A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
rightNotes: 145:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
units.rightText: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.

units.leftText: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
units.rightText: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.

units.leftText: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
units.rightText: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—

units.leftText: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
units.rightText: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.

units.leftText: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
units.rightText: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.

units.leftText: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
units.rightText: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
units.rightText: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.

units.leftText: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
units.rightText: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.

units.leftText: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
units.rightText: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.

units.leftText: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
units.rightText: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,

units.leftText: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
units.rightText: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.

units.leftText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
units.rightText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
leftNotes: 145:13 Some manuscripts omit these last two lines.
rightNotes: 145:13 The final two lines are supplied by one MT manuscript, LXX, Syriac, and DSS.

units.leftText: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
units.rightText: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

units.leftText: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
units.rightText: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.

units.leftText: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
units.rightText: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
units.rightText: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.

units.leftText: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
units.rightText: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.

units.leftText: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
units.rightText: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.

units.leftText: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
units.rightText: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.

units.leftText: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
units.rightText: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
leftNotes: 146:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
146:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 146:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 10

units.leftText: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
units.rightText: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

units.leftText: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
units.rightText: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.

units.leftText: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
units.rightText: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.

units.leftText: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
units.rightText: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

units.leftText: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
units.rightText: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.

units.leftText: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
units.rightText: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,

units.leftText: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
units.rightText: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
units.rightText: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.

units.leftText: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 146:10 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
leftNotes: 147:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 147:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 20

units.leftText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
units.rightText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
leftNotes: 147:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
units.rightText: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

units.leftText: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
units.rightText: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.

units.leftText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
units.rightText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.

units.leftText: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
units.rightText: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,

units.leftText: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
units.rightText: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.

units.leftText: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
units.rightText: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.

units.leftText: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
units.rightText: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

units.leftText: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
units.rightText: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
units.rightText: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!

units.leftText: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
units.rightText: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.

units.leftText: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
units.rightText: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.

units.leftText: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
units.rightText: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.

units.leftText: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
units.rightText: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;

units.leftText: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
units.rightText: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
rightNotes: 147:17 Or like crumbs or like morsels

units.leftText: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
units.rightText: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.

units.leftText: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
units.rightText: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.

units.leftText: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 147:20 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 147:20 MT; DSS and LXX He has not made known to them His judgments

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
leftNotes: 148:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
148:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 148:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 14
148:1 See Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Mark 11:10, and Luke 19:38.

units.leftText: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
units.rightText: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.

units.leftText: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
units.rightText: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.

units.leftText: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
units.rightText: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.

units.leftText: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
units.rightText: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
units.rightText: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,

units.leftText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
units.rightText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,

units.leftText: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
units.rightText: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

units.leftText: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
units.rightText: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,

units.leftText: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
units.rightText: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,

units.leftText: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
units.rightText: young men and maidens, old and young together.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

units.leftText: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 148:14 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song — His praise in the assembly of the godly.
leftNotes: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 149:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 9

units.leftText: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
units.rightText: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.

units.leftText: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
units.rightText: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.

units.leftText: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
units.rightText: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

units.leftText: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
units.rightText: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.

units.leftText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
units.rightText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,

units.leftText: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
units.rightText: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

units.leftText: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
units.rightText: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,

units.leftText: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 149:9 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
leftNotes: 150:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 150:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 6
150:1 Or in the expanse of His might or in the firmament of His might; see also Genesis 1:6–8|GEN 1:6-8*.

units.leftText: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
units.rightText: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.

units.leftText: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
units.rightText: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

units.leftText: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
units.rightText: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.

units.leftText: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
units.rightText: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.

units.leftText: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
